raw_response: {"diagnosis": "On 2026-01-16 the payments source renamed status POSTED to SETTLED with unchanged meaning. Every transaction in batches 12-14 now carries SETTLED or REVERSED, so the filter status = 'POSTED' drops all of them from silver and from every gold table built on it. The fix treats SETTLED as equivalent to POSTED and still excludes REVERSED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.93, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
